title: pandanus tectorius var. menziesii
intro: Pandanus tectorius var. menziesii, commonly known as Screw Pine or Fan Palm, is a species of plant in the Pandanus genus. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures, particularly in the Pacific Islands, for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. The health benefits of Pandanus tectorius var. menziesii are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as soothing digestive issues and relieving respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
